name: Architectural Plastic Sign Letters
description: Formed plastic letters are a great value. Add more dimension with this popular plastic sign letters choice for companies on a budget. Ships in 3 to 5 days. Guaranteed for life, these letters are made to last. The formed shape of the plastic letter produces high dimension and allows for LED lights to be tucked behind for an illuminated sign if desired. Made from renewable resources, CAB plastic is not petroleum based, and comes in lots of colors. In the event you want to change the look of your sign someday, the letters can be recycled.The standard finish for Formed Plastic Sign Letters is a slick gloss, but matte finishes can be put on the letters for an additional cost. If you don't see a color that works with your branding, we can color match to a Pantone number or any other color system. Custom logos can be made to accessorize your lettering, reinforcing the brand and producing a complete plastic sign.Mounting hardware and template must be ordered with plastic letters for easy install. Stud Mount, Pad Mount, and Combination flush mount on the surface and Combination All sets the plastic letter off the surface to produce a drop shadow and higher dimensionality or can be used for uneven surfaces.Each plastic letter is made custom per order so production cannot be rushed, and this product is not returnable. Contact Us with questions regarding sizes, finishes, or mounting.

name: 19" x 32" A-Frame Sidewalk Sign w/ Poster Snap Rails, Double Sided -
description: Dont limit yourself to a specific poster size with this snap rail sidewalk sign, as it offers dimension versatility and placement options. Each lightweight and portable outdoor a-frame provides a blank canvas for signage measuring up to 19" x 32". Simply insert your poster display into the top and bottom plastic banner holders and click them closed, then using the double sided tape provided position and adhere to the white sidewalk sign. Advertising is made easy with this a-frame that offers signage options for quick graphic changes. Each sidewalk sign folds closed for a compact storage option. Place this a-frame outdoor on your storefront curb to grab attention and create a custom advertising poster display.
